prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity Android OCR application design review board, PORTRAIT PHONE states. Create a crisp large high-resolution landscape design board with SIX tall portrait phone screens in a clean 3 columns by 2 rows grid, enough readable Chinese text, flat front-on UI, minimal thin device borders. Title "竖屏 · 从输入到流式文档", small subtitle "同一结果页的不同状态 · 概念设计". Existing design language: warm ivory background, white paper surfaces, deep forest green accents, restrained sage panels, dark charcoal Chinese sans-serif. App name "随手识别". This is a consumer Android app with ONLY TWO main pages (camera/import home, live result), other functions are bottom sheets. Each tile is a state, not a separate app destination. Labels above six screens: "拍摄 / 导入", "分析文档", "逐段生成", "表格与公式", "模型准备", "完成 / 校对".
1 Home: full large camera preview framing a real printed Chinese laboratory report; big circular shutter bottom center, small "最近记录" left, "导入文件" right, supported types "图片 · PDF · Word · Excel".
2 Same result page immediately after input: toolbar back and "识别结果"; compact source thumbnail and "实验报告.pdf"; status "正在分析第 1 页"; white document reading surface with small subtle placeholders, no fake percent; small caption "提取文字，必要时识别图片".
3 Same result page genuinely looks midway through streaming rendered Markdown: document heading "材料实验记录", subheading "实验目的", two rendered paragraphs with bold emphasis, last sentence cut off naturally and a green text caret; status "正在生成"; bottom "停止" active and "导出" disabled. Render styled content, NOT markdown syntax in user view.
4 Same result page later in stream: completed heading, readable simple two-column table "温度 / 伸长量", values 20°C 0.12mm and 40°C 0.28mm; a nicely typeset equation ΔL = αL₀ΔT; following paragraph mid-generation with caret; small placeholder "正在整理下一段…". Clear visual emphasis on the live Markdown document.
5 Same result page dimmed behind a bottom sheet "识别模型", source "ModelScope", two files "版面模型" completed and "内容模型" downloading, 46% progress, "暂停", note "准备完成后继续识别". NOT a separate full page.
6 Same result page complete: well typeset rich text, table, formula, status "已完成", bottom "校对" and "导出", small button "查看原图".
Board footer concise processing distinction: "可提取内容 → 直接解析    扫描内容 → 转为图片识别    混合文档 → 按页处理". Do not add sidebar, bottom tab navigation, irrelevant analytics, slogans or marketing. Pixel-polished spacing and high legibility. All screens portrait aspect ~9:19.5. Illustrative state values only. Opaque background.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity Android OCR app responsive LANDSCAPE PHONE design review board. Create a large crisp high-resolution board with THREE wide landscape smartphone screens stacked vertically, flat front view minimal thin device outline, each screen approximately 20:9. Title "横屏 · 原文与实时文档并排", subtitle "旋转后保留任务与阅读位置 · 概念设计". Same application style throughout: warm ivory backdrop, white document panels, forest green primary controls, sage subtle surfaces, charcoal Chinese sans-serif. App "随手识别". Clear readable simplified Chinese. These are states of ONE result screen, no complex navigation.
Screen 1 label "用户版 · 逐段流式输出". Compact toolbar top "识别结果", filename "实验报告.pdf", small green LIVE and status "正在生成". Main area split 35% left original photographed laboratory report with page selector "1 / 3", 65% right LIVE RENDERED MARKDOWN document, title "材料实验记录", bold subheading "实验目的", rendered bold phrases and paragraphs; final line halfway through a sentence ending in green caret. Right bottom compact "停止" active and "导出" disabled. Thin divider with small drag handle. No markdown syntax, no logs in user version.
Screen 2 label "用户版 · 表格与公式逐步成形". SAME split screen later: left source original scanned page, right elegant document with subheading "测量数据", readable two-column table "温度 / 伸长量", entries "20°C / 0.12 mm", "40°C / 0.28 mm", typeset formula ΔL = αL₀ΔT. Below completed table, next paragraph actively streaming with caret. Status "第 2 / 3 页 · 正在识别". A small "回到最新" chip indicates user has scrolled away. Show rich text as primary content, not source code.
Screen 3 label "测试版 · 按需展开诊断". Same result screen, not a dashboard: upper part left original with thin labeled region boxes and right live rendered Markdown. Modest bottom diagnostics drawer occupying at most 25% phone height, title "处理详情 · DEBUG", route "第 1 页：直接解析 → 第 2 页：渲染 → OCR", sample technical detail "版面分析 / 区域识别", and a short raw markdown snippet "# 材料实验记录". Tabs "处理路径", "原始增量", "耗时". Clear separation of rendered output vs raw debug text. Top small "测试模式" toggle on. Final board footnote "用户版隐藏诊断入口；测试版可切回用户界面". Keep screenshot UI realistic for short landscape phone height, compact toolbar, clear reading space, no sidebars or extraneous pages. Opaque background.
